exceptions.finding: Document lacks mandatory installer/user responsibility disclaimer on face or reverse.
exceptions.regulatory_ref: FAA Order 8130.21J para 3-3 & Appendix A / FAA SUP Notice (AOG Technics)
exceptions.details: AOG Technics forged release forms systematically omitted or truncated the mandatory installer responsibility legal notice. Unapproved template detected.
exceptions.recommendation: QUARANTINE PART IMMEDIATELY. Suspected Unapproved Part (SUP) alert; verify airworthiness tag directly with issuing CRS or FAA FSDO.

exceptions.rule_name: Opposing Release Box Block 13 Not Shaded for Maintenance Release
exceptions.finding: Block 13 is not shaded/grayed out despite maintenance release executed in Block 14.
exceptions.regulatory_ref: FAA Order 8130.21J para 3-7(f) / FAA SUP Advisory
exceptions.details: Failure to shade unused Block 13 allows fraudulent post-release endorsement.
exceptions.recommendation: Hold delivery. Require issuing repair station to provide properly formatted release.

exceptions.rule_name: OEM Nomenclature Mismatch - Generic AOG Technics Red Flag
exceptions.finding: Block 7 description 'bushing' does not match official CFM International IPC nomenclature 'BUSHING SHRD (IGV)'.
exceptions.regulatory_ref: FAA SUP Notice 2023 / CFM International Advisory Notice
exceptions.details: Part number 322-049-204-0 corresponds to official OEM nomenclature 'BUSHING SHRD (IGV)'. Generic colloquial term 'bushing' matches forged tag profile.
exceptions.recommendation: Quarantine article. Cross-examine illustrated parts catalog and demand OEM trace.

exceptions.rule_name: Certificate Number Mismatch: Block 4 vs Block 14c
exceptions.finding: Issuing organization certificate in Block 4 ('CRS FAKE123A') does not match Block 14c certificate ('CRS MISMATCH999B').
exceptions.regulatory_ref: FAA Order 8130.21J para 3-7(d) / AOG Technics SUP Precedent
exceptions.details: In maintenance releases, Block 14c MUST record the certificate number of the organization named in Block 2 and Block 4. Mismatch indicates unauthorized or fraudulent signature.
exceptions.recommendation: QUARANTINE. High probability of fraudulent airworthiness approval. File FAA Form 8120-11 SUP report.
